summary: Wetour Robotics filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release announcing that its subsidiary is pursuing a non-binding cooperation agreement with a warehouse automation company to support its Orchestra project. No definitive agreement, terms, or deal value are stated; management only preliminarily estimates potential project-level gross profit of ~US$5.0 million, subject to site authorizations. This is a routine business development update, not a special situation. The filing discloses no acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other event category. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for definitive agreement execution and customer site approvals.
